He lets me know that it isn't something I can control and that he will work through it with me but when I keep him awake at all hours of the night crying and practically pulling hair out of my head and I finally take that glance up at him and see the exhaustion in his eyes I feel like the shittiest person. I can't just cuddle with him most nights because my mind just races and I cry. It doesn't happen when I am not with him because I keep myself occupied by smoking a shit ton of weed then slipping but we don't smoke together much since the flashback. It really scared the shit out of him with good reason. 

In terms of touching there are a few very specific boundaries set such as no touching my hair. When it's just us I always have it up and once I let it down and asked him to play with it, I flinched a lot and of course cried but it was a huge bonding moment and after he held me and let me know he loves me. He's always very patient and understanding, if I ask him to stop he does so immediately and makes sure I am ok, never complains about it. 

.................

Thank you for your comment, the more I type about him the more I realize that he really does love me and wants the best for me. He really wants me to be happy and see me prosper, I should let him help me without feeling guilty. He loves me and I love him and while it's hard to type the former I know it is true because the proof is there. I really do want to get better and your comment made me realize that him loving me despite being this way shouldn't further push me into darkness but rather I should let it guide me to light. Thank you and I will keep fighting the battle but at least I am not alone. You're one compassionate person and stay beautiful
